senses.gloss: m. pl. (נָשָׂא) taking in marriage (v. אֵרוּסִין); married state.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:4">Keth. I, 4</cite> <he>אלמנה … מן הנ׳</he> a widow, a divorced woman … after having been actually married, opp. to <he>מן הארוסין</he>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 23a:2">Yeb. 23ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:15">Deut. XXI, 15</cite>) <he>אהובה בנִישּׂוּאֶיהָ וכ׳</he> beloved for her (blameless) marriage, hated for her (illicit) marriage. Ib. 64ᵇ <he>נ׳ ומלקיות</he> as to marrying (a third time), and as to the treatment of one twice lashed; a. fr.
